jobs.title: Product Trainer
jobs.description: About Parloa Parloa's mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale. About the role: As a Product Trainer, you will lead the charge in developing and delivering impactful enablement curricula and workshop programs for our cutting-edge SaaS platform. Based in our Berlin office, you’ll work closely with our product teams, expert internal implementers and commercial teams to ensure all stakeholders understand and maximize the platform’s potential. This role is perfect for a professional who thrives in a startup environment, is comfortable at designing, delivering and managing enablement programs, excels at creating training from the ground up, and is adept at bridging global teams with local execution. Areas of ownership: Build and deliver engaging enablement programs for internal teams, customers, and partners, both in-person and virtually. Tailor content to suit diverse skill levels and user needs. Partner with the US team to align global training initiatives with local execution. Stay on top of product updates and trends, ensuring up-to-date training content. Run internal enablement training programs. Serve as a product expert for internal and external stakeholders. Test new features and gather user insights to enhance training and inform product improvements. Implement knowledge checks to measure program effectiveness. jobs.title: AI Trainer - Video Annotation
jobs.description: AI Trainer - Video Annotation Remote | Independent Contractor Prove your skills. Get certified. Robotics AI is advancing rapidly, and high-quality video data helps intelligent systems better understand the world around them. We are inviting detail-oriented professionals to complete our certification process for potential robotics AI projects. ▌ What you will do As part of the certification process, you will demonstrate your ability to: Annotate short video clips by identifying objects, actions and events. Evaluate video quality, relevance and accuracy against established guidelines. Assess the clarity and plausibility of movements. Apply instructions consistently and identify potential quality issues. ▌ What you bring Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking. Strong written English and the ability to follow detailed instructions independently. A commitment to accuracy and consistency. No previous AI or robotics experience required. ▌ What the work looks like You may review short videos and be asked to tag objects or actions, rate video clarity or camera angles on a 1 to 10 scale, or assess whether movements are clearly visible and plausible. Please note: We currently have three projects open, and completing the certification process will allow us to evaluate which project may be the best fit for you.
